lines.en: Mohamed, I would rather you did not smoke here. The lobby is crowded, and the smell reaches guests.
lines.pt: Mohamed, prefiro que você não fume aqui. O saguão está cheio, e o cheiro chega aos hóspedes.

lines.en: Sorry, Zane, I did not notice the sign. I would rather you told me straight away than stare at me.
lines.pt: Desculpe, Zane, não vi a placa. Prefiro que você me diga logo a ficar me olhando.

lines.en: Fair point. Honestly, I would rather the hotel had a proper smoking area, but the manager refuses to build one.
lines.pt: Justo. Sinceramente, preferia que o hotel tivesse uma área para fumantes, mas o gerente se recusa a construir uma.

lines.en: I understand. I was about to go outside anyway. Would you rather I waited near the door or walked to the corner?
lines.pt: Entendo. Eu ia sair de qualquer jeito. Você prefere que eu espere perto da porta ou ande até a esquina?

lines.en: I would rather you walked to the corner. The wind carries the smoke inside,.
lines.pt: Prefiro que você ande até a esquina. O vento leva a fumaça para dentro.

lines.en: Fine. To be honest, I would rather give up smoking altogether, but I have tried twice, and I failed both times.
lines.pt: Tudo bem. Para ser sincero, preferiria largar o cigarro de vez, mas tentei duas vezes e fracassei nas duas.

lines.en: My brother says he would rather you did not talk about it until you feel ready.
lines.pt: Meu irmão diz que prefere que você não fale sobre isso até se sentir pronto.

lines.en: Thank you. By the way, would you rather I covered the evening shift tonight?
lines.pt: Obrigado. Aliás, você prefere que eu cubra o turno da noite hoje?

lines.en: Actually, yes. I would rather you took it, because I have a dentist appointment early tomorrow, and I need sleep.
lines.pt: Na verdade, sim. Prefiro que você fique com ele, porque tenho consulta no dentista cedo amanhã e preciso dormir.

lines.en: Done. I will tell the manager that I would rather work nights than lose another weekend this month.
lines.pt: Combinado. Vou dizer ao gerente que prefiro trabalhar à noite a perder outro fim de semana este mês.

lines.en: Good idea. And Paulo, thanks for being so understanding. Some guests would rather complain than listen.
lines.pt: Boa ideia. E Paulo, obrigada por ser tão compreensivo. Alguns hóspedes preferem reclamar a ouvir.

facts.label: Pedir com educação
facts.sub: I would rather you did not…, would you rather I…?, I would rather work nights.

facts.label: I would rather you left
facts.sub: Use would rather + outro sujeito + passado simples para dizer o que prefere que alguém faça: I would rather you did not smoke here. O passado dá um tom educado, mas o sentido é presente ou futuro.

facts.label: I would rather leave
facts.sub: Quando o sujeito é o mesmo, use would rather + verbo sem to: I would rather work nights. Para comparar, use than: I would rather work nights than lose a weekend.

pages.title: Mito ou fato? · 1/2

items.s: I would rather you did not smoke uses a past form for a present meaning.
items.why: Yes, it is a polite request.

items.s: I would rather you to leave is correct.
items.why: We use the past simple: I would rather you left.

items.s: Would rather + same subject takes the base verb.

pages.instruction: Decida e explique com suas palavras.

solo: Aluno responde e justifica; você mostra a pista.
group: Cada aluno decide sozinho, depois compare as respostas e peça uma justificativa.
Corrija pela pista do texto, não só dizendo “certo/errado”.
extra90: Peça que cada aluno invente uma pergunta igual para o colega.
answers: I would rather you did not smoke uses a past form for a present meani… → Verdadeiro (Yes, it is a polite request.)
I would rather you to leave is correct. → Falso (We use the past simple: I would rather you left.)
Would rather + same subject takes the base verb. → Verdadeiro (I would rather go.)

pages.title: Polite requests in a lobby · 1/3
paragraphs: It is a rainy evening in Portland. Nell works at the front desk of a hotel. Paulo is her colleague on the evening shift. The lobby is full of tired guests. A sign on the wall says no smoking. Nell sees Paulo near the door.

“Paulo, I would rather you did not smoke here. The lobby is crowded, and the smell reaches guests.” says Nell. “Sorry, Nell, I did not notice the sign. I would rather you told me straight away than stare at me.” says Paulo. “Fair point. Honestly, I would rather the hotel had a proper smoking area, but the manager refuses to build one.” says Nell.
